content:
“The Wasteland is tough but you're tougher!”

**Hardy** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Take less damage from explosions.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Take 45% less damage from explosions. | 00393F59 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Take 30% less damage from explosions. | 00393F57 | 
| ★ | 1 | Take 15% less damage from explosions. | 00393F55 | 

- Outside of player versus player, fire damage is fairly rare - dealt only by floater flamers, anglers and NPC Molotov cocktails and flamers.
- As of patch 1.0.4.13, this perk also reduces explosion damage by 15% per rank.
- As of patch 1.0.5.10, this perk also reduces damage from Molotov cocktails.
- Before patch 1.7.23.30, the perk was named Fireproof.

- **(Self-harm explosion immunity):** If the player joins a server with Fireproof 1/2 equipped, they will be immune to physical-type explosive damage produced by their own weapons, rather than being reduced by 15%/30%/45%. [verified] - Unequipping and reequipping the perk, or different ranks of the perk, may restore intended functionality, however this is unreliable in testing. [1] 
 - Repaired at 2023.7.18, in patch 1.7.5.4.
